## Description

Combines Matrix Product States (MPS) tensor network contractions with quantum adiabatic evolution algorithms to solve high-dimensional portfolio allocation problems with complex non-linear entanglement constraints.

## Where it may fit

Large-scale institutional asset allocation with non-convex risk constraints and high combinatorial complexity.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Hedge Funds, Advanced Multi-Asset Allocation Desks.

## Required data

Multi-asset historical return covariance tensors, expected returns vector, cardinality constraint limits.

## Caveats

Tensor network bond dimensions and quantum annealer qubit embedding require rigorous numerical tuning.
